Darakaraka.description: Significator of spouse and marriage partner. The planet with the LOWEST degree becomes the Darakaraka. Its sign, dignity, and D9 position describe the spouse's nature.

Gnatikaraka.description: Significator of enemies, diseases, and obstacles. Its Dasha can bring confrontations but also the strength to overcome them.

Matrikaraka.description: Significator of mother, formal education, property, and emotional comfort.

Putrakaraka.description: Significator of children, intelligence, creativity, and past-life merit (Purva Punya). Check D7 for progeny details.
